# [Imagine Overview](https://docs.x.ai/developers/model-capabilities/imagine#imagine-overview)
## [Image Generation](https://docs.x.ai/developers/model-capabilities/imagine#image-generation)
```
import xai_sdk

client = xai_sdk.Client()

response = client.image.sample(
    prompt="A collage of London landmarks in a stenciled street‑art style",
    model="grok-imagine-image-2.0",
)

print(response.url)
```

```
curl -X POST https://api.x.ai/v1/images/generations \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $XAI_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "model": "grok-imagine-image-2.0",
    "prompt": "A collage of London landmarks in a stenciled street‑art style"
  }'
```

```
import { xai } from "@ai-sdk/xai";
import { generateImage } from "ai";

const { image } = await generateImage({
    model: xai.image("grok-imagine-image-2.0"),
    prompt: "A collage of London landmarks in a stenciled street‑art style",
});

console.log(image.base64);
```

## [Video Generation](https://docs.x.ai/developers/model-capabilities/imagine#video-generation)
```
import os
import xai_sdk

client = xai_sdk.Client(api_key=os.getenv("XAI_API_KEY"))

response = client.video.generate(
    prompt="Make the water crash down and slowly pan out the camera",
    model="grok-imagine-video-1.5",
    image_url="https://docs.x.ai/assets/api-examples/video/waterfall-still.png",
    duration=12,
)

print(response.url)
```

## API Usage: Code Examples [#](https://crazyrouter.com/en/blog/grok-imagine-complete-guide-2026#api-usage-code-examples)
### cURL Example [#](https://crazyrouter.com/en/blog/grok-imagine-complete-guide-2026#curl-example)
```bash
curl https://api.crazyrouter.com/v1/images/generations \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "model": "grok-2-image",
    "prompt": "A futuristic Tokyo street at night, neon signs reflecting on wet pavement, cyberpunk aesthetic, ultra detailed, 8k",
    "n": 1,
    "size": "1024x1024"
  }'
```

### Python Example [#](https://crazyrouter.com/en/blog/grok-imagine-complete-guide-2026#python-example)
```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="YOUR_API_KEY",
    base_url="https://api.crazyrouter.com/v1"
)

response = client.images.generate(
    model="grok-2-image",
    prompt="A serene Japanese garden in autumn, koi pond with maple leaves floating on the surface, golden hour lighting, photorealistic",
    n=1,
    size="1024x1024"
)

image_url = response.data[0].url
print(f"Generated image: {image_url}")
```

### Node.js Example [#](https://crazyrouter.com/en/blog/grok-imagine-complete-guide-2026#node-js-example)
```javascript
import OpenAI from "openai";

const client = new OpenAI({
  apiKey: "YOUR_API_KEY",
  baseURL: "https://api.crazyrouter.com/v1"
});

const response = await client.images.generate({
  model: "grok-2-image",
  prompt: "An astronaut riding a horse on Mars, Earth visible in the sky, cinematic lighting, hyper-detailed",
  n: 1,
  size: "1024x1024"
});

console.log(`Generated image: ${response.data[0].url}`);
```

# Apidog: A Real Design-first API Development Platform
## Using the xAI API for image generation (developer guide)
### Your first image generation request
```bash
curl https://api.x.ai/v1/images/generations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $XAI_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "grok-imagine-image",
    "prompt": "a photorealistic mountain lake at sunrise, mist over the water",
    "n": 1,
    "response_format": "url"
  }'
```

### Python example
```python
import os
import requests

api_key = os.environ["XAI_API_KEY"]

response = requests.post(
    "https://api.x.ai/v1/images/generations",
    headers={
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    },
    json={
        "model": "grok-imagine-image",
        "prompt": "a cyberpunk city street at night, neon reflections in rain puddles",
        "n": 1,
        "response_format": "url"
    }
)

data = response.json()
image_url = data["data"][0]["url"]
print(f"Image URL: {image_url}")
```
